description: This is the main application component for a React-based frontend of an insurance claim fraud detection platform. It handles routing, navigation, and layout structure, including the sidebar and topbar components, and manages protected routes with authentication.

classes.name: Sidebar
classes.description: A React functional component rendering the sidebar navigation menu with links to different sections of the app.

classes.name: Topbar
classes.description: A React functional component rendering the top bar with page titles, subtitles, and action buttons, tailored to the current route.

methods.name: Sidebar()
methods.description: Defines the Sidebar component, rendering navigation links with active styling.

methods.name: Topbar()
methods.description: Defines the Topbar component, showing dynamic titles, subtitles, and sign-out functionality.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main application component that sets up routing and layout, wrapping pages with authentication requirements.
